children: UK private equity investor's half-year profit before tax fell yr/yr to £22.8 mln
NAV rose to £372.2 mln from £360.2 mln at end-January
Company paid £13.0 mln in dividends and launched £2.0 mln share buyback
Company intends to pay at least £7.0 mln in dividends for year ending Jan 2028
Company says it is well positioned to pursue new investments and shareholder returns
Company sees opportunities from sector consolidation and maturing portfolio for capital recycling
CAPITAL RECYCLING - Co said results were driven by converting portfolio value into cash, returning capital to shareholders, and reinvesting in new and existing investments
INCOME-GENERATING STRUCTURES - Growth in loan book and preferred returns from investments contributed to higher portfolio income
PORTFOLIO VALUE GAINS - Broad-based increases in portfolio company valuations, notably ATC, Sodalis, Oneglobal, Volt, Ai Marine and Devonshire, supported NAV growth
